# Case study sources

The published case studies are claude.ai artifacts (links in the handovers). This folder keeps page sources (one folder per case study, each with a `README.md` entry; this index is generated by
`npm run docs`, never edited by hand) so a new
chat can reuse the Sitefloor bar, footer and patterns without re-reading a published page.

- `aldous-marr/index.html`: the jeweller case study (a stone under a loupe, read from table to culet: the hero is the
  Solitaire under a loupe you move yourself; Table is the home page, Crown Starter, Girdle Plus, Pavilion Signature,
  Culet the facts and speed; live engraving inside a band). Media (four clips, stills, worn photographs) live in the
  published artifact under `media/`.
- `calder-wyke/index.html`: the law firm case study (a deed between the firm and its website: an indenture-cut sheet,
  This Deed with its parties, Recitals (A)(B)(C), operative clauses 1–7 as the features with exhibits CW1–CW10 from the
  demo, a live probate estimator and a live if-there's-no-will; Schedules 1–3 are the plans; "time is of the essence"
  is the speed; executed under a blind CW stamp; a magpie palette, Literata and Geologica). Media (ten phone stills,
  780×1688) live in `media/` and the published artifact.
- `corbel/index.html`: the electrician case study (the lighting plan of a website: the page opens dark on Corbel's
  house at dusk with one rotary dimmer, and the dial lights the photograph and every light drawn further down; a
  reflected ceiling plan where each room is a page of the site and each light, L01 to L17, a feature, its symbol the
  plan it comes on (downlight Starter, luminaire Plus, pendant Signature); the chapters are the schedule of fittings;
  a live fault guide and a live whole-house estimate from the demo's figures; the plans are three positions on the
  dial, Low, Evening, Full; the speed is "from the switch to the light"; drafting film with Corbel's blue as the ink
  and the light the one warm colour; Encode Sans Expanded and Encode Sans). Media (two phone clips, the house in 3D
  and the charger in 3D as 960×540 clips, posters, five phone stills, the demo's hero and garden-room photographs)
  live in the published artifact under `media/`. Phone clips: CDP screencast at 390×844 and 2x; 3D clips: one
  screenshot per frame with the page's animation clock stepped by hand, so the software renderer can't make them choppy.
- `datum-hire/index.html`: the car hire case study (directions to your door: the site read as the night drive that brings
  the car, a sat-nav instruction as the hero, one amber route line with each feature a stop at its mile marker, the plans
  as three motorway junctions on blue road-sign plates, the speed as the journey time, a live Delivered tonight with the
  demo's figures; night navy, Overpass and Overpass Mono). Media (four clips, posters, stills, four car photos) live in
  the published artifact under `media/`. Clips: Playwright at 390×844, scaled to 780 wide.
- `fennick-lowe/index.html`: the tailor case study (cut to pattern: the page opens on Fennick & Lowe's charcoal flannel
  with a coat's manila pattern pieces laid on it, each piece a page of the site; tap one and a chalk line goes round it
  while that page shows on a phone lying on the cutting table; the pattern ticket lists every piece and the plan it
  comes on; chapters per piece (the cloth book and swatch set, the commission by code, the wedding party planner, from
  your pattern) with phone clips, and the specification card live on the page from the demo's own photographs; the
  plans are garments by their pieces, trousers (two), a jacket (five), the three-piece (up to twenty), each drawn as a
  cutter's marker; the speed is "measured twice", under a tape; Della Respira and Commissioner). Media (four phone
  clips with posters, nine phone stills, the cloth and the coat-on-stand photographs, specification and cloth tiles)
  live in the published artifact under `media/`. Phone clips: CDP screencast at 390×844 and 2x, encoded H.264.
- `grenat/index.html`: the grand café case study (a three-tier stand: Starter, Plus, Signature as savouries, scones and
  pâtisserie). Media (two phone clips, stills from the demo) live only in the published artifact.
- `hatheli/index.html`: the mehndi artist case study (dated to your wedding: the hero is one sentence, "My wedding is on
  Saturday 12 June 2027", its day, month and year set huge as the fields themselves, answered live from the demo's
  diary with the mehndi evening, the darkest day and the days left; every chapter below is a day of the bride's week
  counted back from that date, its number very large, Today, the trial, the outfit, the mehndi evening, paste off,
  the wedding, each re-dated when she changes hers; the ground follows the stain, bone for the bare palm, paste black
  for the mehndi night, the first orange for paste off, the darkest brown for the wedding; a live guest sum and a live
  "send to the family" message from the demo's own figures; "Your stain, day by day" described as Signature, from each
  artist's own photographs; the plans are three shades of one stain, Paste off, Overnight, On the day; the speed is
  "open before her hands are dry"; the demo's own Rozha One and Source Serif 4). Media (five phone clips with posters,
  four phone stills, the demo's window and chooda photographs) live in the published artifact under `media/`. Clips:
  Playwright screenshots at 390×844 and 2x, the demo ribbon hidden, stitched with ffmpeg at 10 fps.
- `isotach/index.html`: the clothing-brand case study (a wind chart: lines of moving air bend around the phone; each
  feature is a numbered station; plans are wind barbs, Starter one feather, Plus two, Signature the pennant; no phone
  frame). Media (seven phone clips, posters, the kit card, demo photos) live in the published artifact under `media/`.
  Clips: recorded with Playwright at 390×844, cropped from the frame's top-left quarter and upscaled to 780 wide.
- `laleh/index.html`: the social-first florist case study (her Instagram DMs: the page is one conversation, each
  chapter a customer's message set huge in italic on the left, often with the post they shared, and the reply from
  the right as Laleh's website answering it on a phone; the hero thread arrives once on load; live replies to "can
  you make this one?" (the real link check), "can u deliver today" (Laleh's cut-offs on London time) and "when's the
  next drop" (a countdown to Friday 7pm); the plans are pinned posts, one pin Starter, two Plus, three Signature;
  the speed is the message's "Delivered"; paper white with one peony, the messages the only round shapes; Tenor Sans
  and Spectral). Media (seven phone clips with posters, three phone stills, four demo photographs) live in the
  published artifact under `media/`. Clips: CDP screencast at 390×844 and 2x in full Chromium with `--lang=en-GB`
  (the headless shell ignores it, so date fields come out in US order), stitched with ffmpeg.
- `larchmere/index.html`: the wedding film case study (read by the sun's height: the page opens on Larchmere's film
  edge to edge with a live headline worked out from the sun's real elevation over Bibury now ("In Bibury the sun is
  8° up. Golden hour begins today at 15:34", "It's golden hour in Bibury now…"), and a degree scale down the left edge
  as the index with a glowing sun at its current height; each chapter sits at a height, +40° the film, +20° your date,
  +6° golden hour (with a live golden-hour field for any date), 0° the day, −4° your film, and its ground darkens from
  ivory to night; the plans at −6° are three lights, Daylight (Starter), Golden hour (Plus), Blue hour (Signature),
  each topped with a cut of that sky; the speed is "a degree every four minutes"; the demo's own fonts, Sorts Mill
  Goudy and Urbanist). The sun is NOAA's calculation, as in the kit's `lib/sun.js`. Media (the demo's wide and tall
  film with posters, three phone clips with posters, two phone stills) live in the published artifact under `media/`.
  Phone clips: Playwright screenshots at 390×844 and 2x in full Chromium with `--lang=en-GB` (UK date fields), one per
  step and one per typed letter, stitched with ffmpeg (the CDP screencast came out at 1x).
- `lyall-harrow/index.html`: the private wealth case study (a website read across fifty years: the page opens on the
  demo's misty shore with the site's own first question, "I am … and I live in …", set large over the photograph and
  answering as the site does; the page is indexed by horizon on one copper hairline, Today 2026, This year 2027, Ten
  years 2036, A generation 2051, Fifty years 2076, each chapter the features a family needs at that distance; a live
  meeting field that refuses account numbers; the showpiece is the firm's insights sheet, editable on the one navy
  band, publishing to the page only when compliance ticks, names and dates a row and holding back any promise of a
  return; a live What to gather per moment, to tick and print; the plans are three horizons, Today, This decade,
  Generations; white with one navy band, copper hairlines, Mona Sans at 125% width for display). Media (six phone
  stills at 780×1688 and five of the demo's photographs) live in `media/` and the published artifact.
- `marese/index.html`: the lingerie case study (a stocking's back seam: one stitched line down the page, each feature a
  suspender clasp on it; plans as deniers, Starter 15, Plus 10, Signature 7, the knit drawn over skin; a skin ground with
  one black; a live hint composer and a countdown to Marese's Valentine's order-by). Media (six phone clips with posters,
  four stills, two demo photos) live in the published artifact under `media/`. Clips: CDP screencast at 390×844 and
  2x (`Page.startScreencast`, 780 wide), stitched with ffmpeg, so they're sharp without upscaling.
- `marlie/index.html`: the teeth whitening case study (the social six: the page opens on a cosmetic dentist's planning
  screen, a real smile in black and white with the guides drawing themselves on it, the midline, the commissure line
  at its measured 2.6°, the smile arc along the edges, and the six front teeth 13 12 11 | 21 22 23 marked with their
  widths against the front tooth; touch a tooth and the readout names it and its chapter. The midline then runs down
  the whole page and each chapter is one of the six, numbered as a dentist numbers it (FDI), opening on the six with
  its own tooth marked and sitting on its own side of the line: 11 the booth strip, 21 tell me what you'd change
  (live, with the demo's words), 12 nothing it can't keep (GDC lines and a live claims check that refuses shade,
  permanence, guarantee, laser and specialist promises as the kit does), 22 when's the big day (live, the demo's
  timings), 13 visit by visit and aftercare, 23 smiles with consent and arriving; the premolars list the rest of the
  site; the plans are the golden proportion, Signature 1.618, Plus 1, Starter 0.618, drawn at those widths; the speed
  is read off a rule in tenths of a second; the demo's own fonts, Reddit Sans and Brygada 1918 italic, with Reddit Mono
  for every measurement). Media (the smile photograph, three phone clips with posters, six phone stills) live in
  `media/` and the published artifact. Phone captures: full Chromium at 390×844 and 2x with `--lang=en-GB`, the demo
  ribbon hidden; the strip clip recorded with CSS animations at a quarter speed (CDP `Animation.setPlaybackRate`)
  and played back at full speed, so it's smooth.

  Photograph credits: `media/smile.webp` (the hero, every chapter's crop and the closing figure) is "Close Up Photo of
  Person's Lips" by Amir SeilSepour, a model photograph, free under the Pexels licence:
  https://www.pexels.com/photo/close-up-photo-of-person-s-lips-11956948/. Every other image and clip is a capture of
  the smile demo, whose photographs are credited in `sites/demos/smile/img/CREDITS.md`.
- `morrow/index.html`: the coffee house case study (one weekday at the counter, 7:30am to 4pm, a clock column down the
  page). Media (three phone clips, stills from the demo) live only in the published artifact.
- `ottoline/index.html`: the reformer Pilates case study (six reformers, one room: the hero is the studio's room seen
  from above, six reformers whose carriages glide in slow, slightly-out-of-time footwork, the teacher at the front, and a
  live "In the room" line from the demo timetable on London time; each person on a reformer is a chapter opening on its
  floor number; the plans are class cards, a punched hole per page: Starter two, Plus five, Signature twenty). Media
  (six phone clips, posters, six demo photographs) live in the published artifact under `media/`. Clips: Playwright
  screenshots at 390×844 and 2x, stitched with ffmpeg (the CDP screencast came out at 1x in this Chromium).
- `pastillage/index.html`: the celebration cake case study (on the stand: the page opens on the demo's No. 22 Verdure,
  four tiers in moss velvet with one white sugar peony, standing full height on warm black; each tier is a chapter and
  a question couples ask (I "Is our date free?", II "How many are you feeding?", III "Will you bring it to us?", IV "Your
  own idea, built for you — quoted after a call"); tap a tier and its features open large below, each with its phone
  screen from the demo and one line on what it does for the studio; the plans light the tiers from the top, one tier
  Starter, two Plus, three Signature, the whole cake Bespoke ("From £1,399, quoted after a call"); speed "measured on a
  phone"; the demo's Chonburi (huge type only) and Golos Text, moss accent from Verdure's velvet). Media (Verdure in two
  sizes, twelve phone stills, 780×1688) live in `media/` and the published artifact. Phone captures: Playwright at
  390×844 and 2x, the demo ribbon hidden, full Chromium with `LANG=en_GB.UTF-8` for UK date order.
- `pellow-garth/index.html`: the construction case study (behind the hoarding: the page is a site hoarding of real OSB
  in portrait 8×4 sheets, the builder's name sprayed through a stencil; the hero is one round viewing window you drag
  along the boards, and through it the finished extension stands where the hoarding is; each feature is another window
  cut into the boards, a page of the site on a phone behind it, with its notice pasted beside it: your house this week
  by site code, the extension against the rules with a live planning board (GOV.UK's rear limits, dated, "a guide, not
  a decision"), the loft in 3D against 40/50 m³, the neighbours' site board, then six more windows in one strip; the
  plans are three hoardings, a short run with one window (Starter), five windows (Plus) and twenty (Signature); the
  speed is painted on the boards, "measured on a phone"; Big Shoulders Stencil Display and the demo's Kumbh Sans on a
  concrete-pale ground). Media (two phone clips with posters, nine phone stills, six OSB sheets cut from one photograph,
  the demo's finished-extension photograph) live in `media/` and the published artifact. Phone captures: Playwright at
  390×844 and 2x, the demo ribbon hidden; the living page in full Chromium (`channel: "chromium"`, `LANG=en_GB.UTF-8`)
  for UK date order; the 3D clips are one screenshot per step at 4 fps, encoded H.264.
- `saffron-and-ash/index.html`: the restaurant case study (ten-course tasting menu). Its media (clips, stills, PDF pages)
  live only in the published artifact; recapture them from the demo if needed (see the handovers, "Case studies").
- `selwyn-orr/index.html`: the hair salon case study (the price list is the photograph: daylight and ivory, Selwyn
  Orr's own salon photograph across the page with the length cut working on it, the hair below the line fading in
  place, and the length, service and stylist level set under it like a catalogue caption with the price from the
  demo's grid; then the site itself a feature at a time on a phone at about actual size, the phone and one plain
  sentence alternating sides: the stylists by their work, every texture, chairs free today, the colour year, find your
  stylist, the blow-dry pass; a line for the rest; the plans as a plain three-column table; measured Lighthouse
  figures; the free mockup; the demo's own Darker Grotesque and Public Sans). Media (the demo's cut photograph and
  hair layer at 2000 wide, six phone stills at 780×1688) live in `media/` and the published artifact. Stills:
  Playwright at 390×844 and 2x, the demo ribbon hidden, clock fixed.
- `tollgarth/index.html`: the garden designer case study (from first light: the page is one day in Richmond, read by
  the sun. The hero is the demo's own example garden drawn in 3D by the kit's sun code, with the shadows of the house
  and fences at the hour you set; it opens at the real time in Richmond (dark at night), with Today, 21 June,
  21 December and "Watch the day", sunrise to sunset in twelve seconds, and the ground of the hero follows the light.
  The contents are a true horizontal sundial for Richmond's latitude, each hour line a chapter, with today's shadow
  on it live; the chapters are hours (VI the year, VIII the studio's month, X the sample table, XII where the sun
  falls, II care on the year, IV ready by, VI do I need permission?), then "after dark" for the other pages; the plans
  are three days, 21 December (Starter), 20 March (Plus), 21 June (Signature), each a dial of that day's hours of light
  worked out live; the speed is "before the shadow moves", how far a fence's shadow moves while the home page loads.
  Copper beech is the one colour; Cinzel and the demo's Alegreya on stone). Media (three phone clips with posters,
  twelve phone stills, the demo's meadow, dusk and path-light photographs) live in `media/` and the published
  artifact. Phone clips: CDP screencast at 390×844 and 2x, resampled to 30 fps, H.264; stills: Playwright at 390×844
  and 2x, the demo ribbon hidden. The kit's sun code (`sun-draw.js`, `sun-study.js`, core `sun.js`) is bundled inline
  with esbuild.
- `varnell/index.html`: the car detailing case study (a car brochure: the cover is Varnell's 3D SUV on a studio
  cyclorama in front of the name set wide, repainted from the demo's paint chart, "approximate on screen"; brochure
  chapters under mono running heads with page numbers, Exterior p.02 to Technical data p.09; the 3D correction and
  film clips as dark plates; a live film price list (package by car) and a live collection check from the demo's own
  data; the plans are trim levels with their standard equipment, each on the same car in another paint; the speed is
  the back page's technical data, "1.4 s to first paint"; Michroma, Geist and Geist Mono on a pale studio grey).
  Media (the SUV rendered from the shared 3D model in the eight chart colours, five clips with posters, the demo's
  headlight photograph) live in the published artifact under `media/`. Phone clips: CDP screencast at 390×844 and 2x
  in full Chromium with `LANG=en_GB.UTF-8` (needed for UK date fields); 3D clips: element screenshots of the stage
  with Playwright's clock stepped 1/30 s per frame. Car renders: three.js with RoomEnvironment, a shadow-catcher
  floor and `VSMShadowMap`, transparent WebP.
- `velvet-spoon/index.html`: the dessert case study (the box: its lid unties, each layer a plan, each piece a feature,
  a guide card, the back-of-box label, plans as box sizes). Media (clips, gift and flight stills, piece cut-outs) live in
  the published artifact under `media/`.
- `verrall/index.html`: the nail atelier case study (the swatch fan: a fan of the 21 house shades opens under a real hand
  and each tip paints it live, on three skin tones; each chapter is a full-bleed field of one house shade, named and
  numbered like the bottle; the plans are three coats, base coat Starter, colour Plus, top coat Signature, over a cut
  through a nail; the speed is drying time; a live bridal planner counts back from one wedding date; lacquer white,
  Newsreader and Be Vietnam Pro). Media (six phone clips with posters, three hands and their masks, stills) live in the
  published artifact under `media/`. Clips: CDP screencast at 390×844 and 2x, each starting already on its subject.
- `wexley/index.html`: the bridal case study (a gown's fittings: the first appointment, first fitting and final
  fitting are Starter, Plus and Signature; a fitting card of the salon's facts; a live gown diary; a pale pearl-oyster
  ground with a champagne accent). Media (three clips, stills, mirror panes) live in the published
  artifact under `media/`.

Every case study must look unrecognisably different from the others, keep the same Sitefloor bar and footer, and never
show how we built anything (CLAUDE.md rule 11a).
